body:
#### PR description:

This PR simplifies the `runHLTTiming.sh` and `compareMemoryProfiles.py` scripts to take advantage of the improvements coming from https://github.com/cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts/pull/61. In order for the merge to be successful (and hopefully not to break any PR/IB tests) this PR should be tested together with https://github.com/cms-sw/cms-bot/pull/2845 and merged together with that PR and the one to cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts

#### PR validation:
 
Purely technical change, to be tested by the bot
title: Update HLT timing script to support new patatrack-scripts functionalities
